name: No-direction day: fade a stretch away from the open
why: On a balancing day the open is fair value; a late stretch away from it reverts. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_no_direction_mr.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && abs(at(9,50) - open) <= 0.25 * atr && abs(at(10,30) - open) <= 0.3 * atr && !(vix >= 20 && (pibs <= 0.3 || rsi2 <= 20)) && abs(px - open) > 0.25 * atr
